welcome.title: Welcome to the Translation Studio
welcome.descStart: Help us localize the Xernerx platform directly within the app! You are translating from our source of truth,
welcome.newEntriesDesc: Tackle missing keys one by one through a distraction-free card interface. Go at your own pace without feeling overwhelmed.
welcome.reviewDesc: Need to fix a typo or refine a translation reported by users? Browse and update all existing translations in a full list.
welcome.footerPart1: Once you are finished translating, click
welcome.footerPart2: at the top right to submit your work to the review branch! Any untranslated or empty entries will be omitted automatically.

guide.title: Before you start
guide.step1: If possible you may require a basic understanding of the English (UK) language
guide.step2: You can choose to either review new entries or modify existing ones
guide.step3: There is no deadline or haste upon these translations, take your time.
guide.step4: When you are changing keys the push to review button will become available, only press this once ready.
guide.step5: While editing try to not close or refresh the page, it may lose unsaved progression.
guide.step6Part1: After submitting you will see your translated keys untranslated again, this is normal. Your changes are automatically merged into the
guide.step6Part2: for testing and review, and will go live with the next deployment.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: This Privacy Policy explains how Xernerx Studios ("we", "our", "us") collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you use our services.

account.title: General Account Information:
account.desc: Email, username, and profile identifiers when you register.

usage.title: Usage Data:
usage.desc: Error logs and system interactions to maintain platform stability.

integration.title: Integration Data:
integration.desc: Data provided through third-party platforms such as Discord, and payment processing details via Stripe.

developers.title: For API & Bot Developers:
developers.desc: API tokens, webhook URLs, application metadata, and configuration settings used to operate your integrations on our infrastructure.

botUsers.title: For Bot End Users:
botUsers.desc: When you interact with a bot powered by Xernerx (e.g. Zodiac, To-Do list), we process your Discord ID, server IDs, and command inputs to execute the requested actions. We do not store raw message logs unless explicitly required by an opt-in bot feature.

legalBasis.title: 3. Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.content: We process personal data based on contractual necessity, legitimate interests, legal obligations, or user consent where applicable.

usage.title: 4. How We Use Information
items: To provide support, communicate platform updates, and send important service-related emails (e.g., billing, security alerts). You may manage your notification preferences or opt-out of non-essential emails at any time.
To ensure compliance with legal obligations.

sharing.title: 5. Data Sharing
items: Payment processors (e.g. Stripe) for billing and subscription management.
Legal authorities when required by law.

retention.title: 6. Data Retention
retention.content: We retain data only as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Policy, unless longer retention is required by law.

security.title: 7. Data Security
security.content: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect data. However, no system is absolutely secure.

rights.title: 8. Your Rights
items: Right to restrict or object to processing.

cookies.title: 9. Cookies & Tracking
cookies.content: We use cookies or similar technologies to improve service performance, store interface preferences, and serve advertisements. This includes third-party services like Google AdSense, which may use cookies to serve personalized ads based on your prior visits to our platform or other websites.

international.title: 10. International Transfers
international.content: If data is transferred outside your jurisdiction, appropriate safeguards are implemented to ensure legal compliance.

changes.title: 11. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Continued use of services indicates acceptance of the revised version.

apiData.title: API Data Collection & Developer Obligations
apiData.content: When developers use our REST API to synchronize bot statistics or fetch metadata, we collect and store this data to render bot pages and provide analytics. Developers are strictly prohibited from transmitting personally identifiable information (PII) of their users to our API unless explicitly requested by an endpoint. We do not sell or share API data with third-party advertisers.

eligibility.title: 2. Eligibility
eligibility.content: You must meet the minimum legal age in your jurisdiction to use our services. By using our services, you represent that you satisfy this requirement.

apiUsage.title: 4. API & Developer Terms
apiUsage.content: Developers using our API or bot infrastructure must adhere to the following rules:
items: Respect rate limits and do not spam or reverse-engineer the API.
You are solely responsible for securing your API keys; we are not liable for leaked tokens.
Data submitted to the platform (such as server stats) must be accurate and not artificially inflated.
We reserve the right to instantly revoke API tokens or suspend bot applications for any abuse or degraded platform performance.

botUsage.title: 5. Bot End User Terms
botUsage.content: Users interacting with Xernerx-powered bots agree not to exploit command inputs to execute malicious payloads or harass other users. Server administrators are responsible for ensuring bots are used in compliance with both these terms and Discord's Terms of Service.

accounts.title: 6. User Accounts

thirdParty.title: 9. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: Our services integrate with third-party platforms such as Discord, Stripe, and Google (for translation and advertising services). We are not responsible for third-party policies, service availability, or independent data practices.

card.title: What are environments?
card.description: Within Xernerx Studios we speak of 3 environments: release (production), canary (beta) and dev (development). Here is what each of them mean:

release.label: Release
release.description: The stable production environment used for general release.

canary.label: Canary
canary.description: The beta environment used for pre-release testing of new features.

dev.label: Dev
dev.description: The development environment used for active building and testing.

card1.title: How do I become a translator?
card1.p1: You can apply directly from the Language preferences page if a language has less than 100% coverage.
card1.p2: Make sure you are logged in and on the account page.

card2.title: How long does it take for an application to be reviewed?
card2.description: Whenever an admin has time to review your submission and merge the translations with the live environment

card3.title: I translated but it didn't update?
card3.description: Translations cannot be automatically applied, the web page needs to be rebuild. Whenever you submit a review we get a notification asking to apply the newly added translations, we will allow this once reviewed.

card4.title: My language is not included in the list, how can I add it?
card4.description: For now you are required to request the language in our support channels, a language base will be created and then you can start translating for us!

common.title: REST API
common.description: The Xernerx {version} API allows developers to programmatically interface with the ecosystem, manage bot statistics, and automate organization workflows.
common.authDesc1: All programmatic API requests across the platform must be authenticated using an API Token generated from your developer dashboard.
common.authDesc2: Internal web requests may also utilize standard NextAuth session cookies.
common.authDesc3: Pass your token in the Authorization HTTP header as a Bearer token.
common.secureDesc: The /secure API routes manage sensitive administrative components (roles, users, etc.). While utilized internally by the dashboard, they can also be accessed by third-party applications if an administrator has explicitly granted the API token the secure passage flag.

fetchBotProfile.title: Fetch Bot Profile
fetchBotProfile.description: Retrieve public or private profile metadata for a specific Discord bot.
fetchBotProfile.privacyDesc: If the requested bot profile is set to private, this endpoint will return a 403 Forbidden error unless the authenticated token belongs to an owner of the bot. If the token is owned by the bot developer, the response will additionally include sensitive properties such as configured{' '}hooks and full arrays of user votes.

updateBotProfile.title: Update Bot Profile
updateBotProfile.description: Update specific fields of your bot's profile programmatically.
updateBotProfile.descField: A short summary of what the bot does (usually used in cards).
updateBotProfile.infoField: A detailed markdown description for the bot's full profile page.
updateBotProfile.tagsField: An array of string categories that apply to the bot.
updateBotProfile.linksField: An object containing URLs like invite, support, or website.

deleteBotProfile.title: Delete Bot Profile
deleteBotProfile.description: Permanently delete your bot's profile from the platform ecosystem.

fetchBotStats.title: Fetch Bot Stats
fetchBotStats.description: Retrieve the statistical history of a specific Discord bot.

postBotStats.title: Post Bot Stats
postBotStats.description: Log a new statistical snapshot for a Discord bot.
postBotStats.nodePackageDesc: If you are using Node.js, you can easily automate your statistics posting using the official @xernerx/stats package without needing to write manual fetch requests.

updateBotStats.title: Update Bot Stats
updateBotStats.description: Update a previously logged statistical snapshot.

deleteBotStats.title: Delete Bot Stats
deleteBotStats.description: Delete all statistical snapshots for a Discord bot.

fetchBotCommands.title: Fetch Bot Commands
fetchBotCommands.description: Retrieve your synced Discord application slash commands.

syncBotCommands.title: Sync Bot Commands
syncBotCommands.description: Bulk synchronize your Discord application slash commands.
syncBotCommands.bulkSyncDesc: The PUT endpoint expects a full array of your Discord application commands. It performs a complete sync by wiping your previously stored commands and bulk-inserting the new array. This is best called during your bot's startup sequence.

deleteBotCommands.title: Delete Bot Commands
deleteBotCommands.description: Wipe all synchronized commands for a Discord bot.

common.serverCountDesc: The number of servers the bot is in (alias for guildCount).
common.userCountDesc: The estimated total number of users across all guilds.

fetchDiscordProfile.title: Fetch Discord Profile
fetchDiscordProfile.description: Fetch a user's Discord profile metadata directly from the Xernerx core caching layer.

fetchDiscordGuilds.title: Fetch Discord Guilds
fetchDiscordGuilds.description: Retrieve a list of Discord guilds that a user is currently a member of.

fetchDiscordGuild.title: Fetch Discord Guild
fetchDiscordGuild.description: Fetch a specific Discord guild's metadata directly from the Xernerx core caching layer.

fetchDiscordRoles.title: Fetch Discord Roles
fetchDiscordRoles.description: Retrieve all available Discord roles within a specific guild.

cdn.title: Xernerx CDN Services
cdn.description: The Xernerx Content Delivery Network securely routes, caches, and accelerates media assets across the entire ecosystem. This documentation covers the internal HTTP API used for programmatically managing uploads and media retrieval.

notice.title: Internal API Usage Notice
notice.description: The CDN is primarily designed as an internal microservice for Xernerx ecosystem applications (like the Account and Admin dashboards). While these endpoints are documented for transparency and advanced developer integrations, they are tightly coupled to the internal authentication flow and are not intended for general public consumption like a standalone SaaS product.
